meanings.en: used to say what is the right or advisable thing to do
meanings.exampleEn: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
meanings.exampleTr: O öksürük için bir doktora görünmelisin.

meanings.en: used to say something is probable or expected
meanings.exampleEn: They left early, so they ought to be there by now.
meanings.exampleTr: Erken çıktılar, dolayısıyla şimdiye kadar orada olmaları gerekir.

meanings.en: belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more others
meanings.exampleEn: Our house is at the end of the street.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizim evimiz sokağın sonunda.

meanings.en: used to refer to something belonging to or connected with the speaker and others
meanings.exampleEn: That car is ours, not theirs.
meanings.exampleTr: O araba bizimki, onlarınki değil.

meanings.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the subject is 'we'
meanings.exampleEn: We taught ourselves how to cook.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek yapmayı kendi kendimize öğrendik.

meanings.en: to force someone out of a position of power, especially so as to take their place
meanings.exampleEn: The rebels ousted the president in a bloodless coup.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar cumhurbaşkanını kansız bir darbeyle görevden uzaklaştırdı.

meanings.en: used to show movement away from the inside of a place or thing
meanings.exampleEn: She took the keys out of her bag.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarları çantasından çıkardı.

meanings.en: no longer having any of something
meanings.exampleEn: We are out of milk again.
meanings.exampleTr: Yine sütümüz kalmadı.

meanings.en: not working together or matching correctly in time or agreement
meanings.exampleEn: The audio was out of sync with the video.
meanings.exampleTr: Ses, görüntüyle senkronize değildi.

meanings.en: a period when a service, especially electricity or the internet, is not available
meanings.exampleEn: The storm caused a power outage that lasted six hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına, altı saat süren bir elektrik kesintisine yol açtı.

meanings.en: clothes such as coats and jackets that you wear over other clothes when outside
meanings.exampleEn: The store sells outerwear for cold winter weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza, soğuk kış havası için dış giyim satıyor.

meanings.en: an amount of money spent on something, especially as an initial investment
meanings.exampleEn: Starting the business required a large initial outlay.
meanings.exampleTr: İşe başlamak büyük bir başlangıç harcaması gerektirdi.

meanings.en: larger than the usual or expected size
meanings.exampleEn: The small company had an outsized influence on the industry.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük şirket, sektör üzerinde olağandışı büyüklükte bir etkiye sahipti.

meanings.en: to be or become greater than something, or to do better than someone
meanings.exampleEn: Demand for the product quickly outstripped supply.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürüne olan talep, arzı hızla aştı.

meanings.en: cooked using the heat of an oven
meanings.exampleEn: These oven-cooked fries are healthier than fried ones.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu fırında pişmiş patatesler, kızartılmış olanlardan daha sağlıklı.

meanings.en: trying to control other people in an unpleasant and forceful way
meanings.exampleEn: His overbearing manner made the staff feel uncomfortable.
meanings.exampleTr: Baskıcı tavrı, personelin kendini rahatsız hissetmesine neden oldu.

meanings.en: the situation in which there are too many people or things in a place
meanings.exampleEn: Overcrowding on the trains has become a serious problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Trenlerdeki aşırı kalabalık ciddi bir sorun haline geldi.

meanings.en: a statement that is too general and does not consider all the facts or exceptions
meanings.exampleEn: Saying all teenagers are lazy is an overgeneralization.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün gençlerin tembel olduğunu söylemek bir aşırı genellemedir.

meanings.tr: fazla maaş alan, hak ettiğinden fazla ödenen
meanings.en: paid too much money for the work you do
meanings.exampleEn: Many people think top executives are overpaid.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok kişi üst düzey yöneticilerin fazla maaş aldığını düşünüyor.

meanings.en: a bridge that carries a road or railway over another road
meanings.exampleEn: Traffic slowed as it approached the overpass.
meanings.exampleTr: Trafik, üst geçide yaklaşırken yavaşladı.

meanings.en: too easily upset or offended by what other people say or do
meanings.exampleEn: She is oversensitive to any kind of criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Her türlü eleştiriye karşı aşırı hassastır.

meanings.en: done or shown openly and not hidden
meanings.exampleEn: There was no overt sign of tension between them.
meanings.exampleTr: Aralarında açık bir gerginlik belirtisi yoktu.

meanings.en: in an open way that is not hidden or secret
meanings.exampleEn: He was never overtly critical of his boss.
meanings.exampleTr: Patronunu asla açıkça eleştirmedi.

meanings.en: used to express sudden pain
meanings.exampleEn: Ow! That really hurt.
meanings.exampleTr: Ah! Bu gerçekten canımı yaktı.

meanings.en: because of; as a result of
meanings.exampleEn: The flight was delayed owing to bad weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçuş kötü hava nedeniyle ertelendi.

meanings.en: an informal word for father
meanings.exampleEn: Pa taught me how to fish when I was young.
meanings.exampleTr: Baba, ben küçükken bana balık tutmayı öğretti.

meanings.en: peaceful in character or intent
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to settle the dispute by pacific means.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmazlığı barışçıl yollarla çözmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: to make someone who is angry or upset become calm and quiet
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to pacify the crying baby.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağlayan bebeği yatıştırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: having the effect of making someone calm or less angry
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke in a soft, pacifying tone.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumuşak, yatıştırıcı bir tonda konuştu.

meanings.en: causing no physical pain
meanings.exampleEn: The procedure is quick and completely painless.
meanings.exampleTr: İşlem hızlı ve tamamen ağrısızdır.

meanings.en: not involving effort or difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: They made the whole process painless for us.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm süreci bizim için zahmetsiz hale getirdiler.

meanings.en: the quality of being light in color or of having little color in the face
meanings.exampleEn: The paleness of her skin worried the doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Cildinin solgunluğu doktoru endişelendirdi.

meanings.en: so obvious that it can be easily felt or noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The tension in the room was palpable.
meanings.exampleTr: Odadaki gerginlik elle tutulur derecedeydi.

meanings.en: a person who stops people in the street and asks them for money
meanings.exampleEn: A panhandler asked me for spare change outside the station.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir dilenci istasyonun önünde benden bozuk para istedi.

meanings.en: a mental health condition in which a person has sudden repeated attacks of intense fear
meanings.exampleEn: She was diagnosed with panic disorder after months of sudden attacks.
meanings.exampleTr: Aylarca süren ani ataklardan sonra ona panik bozukluğu teşhisi kondu.

meanings.en: a low wall along the edge of a roof, bridge, or balcony
meanings.exampleEn: He leaned over the parapet to look at the river below.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşağıdaki nehre bakmak için korkuluk duvarına eğildi.

meanings.en: very dry, especially because of hot weather
meanings.exampleEn: The parched fields had not seen rain for months.
meanings.exampleTr: Kupkuru tarlalar aylardır yağmur görmemişti.

meanings.en: very thirsty
meanings.exampleEn: After the hike I was completely parched.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşten sonra çok susamıştım.

meanings.en: an area where vehicles can be left for a period of time
meanings.exampleEn: The parking area behind the mall was almost full.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışveriş merkezinin arkasındaki park alanı neredeyse doluydu.

meanings.en: to take part in an activity
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone was invited to partake in the celebrations.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes kutlamalara katılmaya davet edildi.

meanings.en: unfair support of one person or group instead of another
meanings.exampleEn: The judge was accused of partiality toward the defendant.
meanings.exampleTr: Hâkim, davalıya karşı taraf tutmakla suçlandı.

meanings.en: a strong liking for something
meanings.exampleEn: He has a partiality for expensive wine.
meanings.exampleTr: Pahalı şaraba karşı bir düşkünlüğü var.

meanings.en: to give information or an object to someone else
meanings.exampleEn: Could you pass on this message to your manager?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu mesajı yöneticine iletir misin?

meanings.en: a polite way to say someone has died
meanings.exampleEn: Her grandmother passed on last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannesi geçen yıl vefat etti.

meanings.en: a polite or medical way to say to urinate
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor asked if it hurt when he passed water.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor, idrar yaparken acıyıp acımadığını sordu.

meanings.en: no longer fashionable or popular
meanings.exampleEn: Those styles look rather passé now.
meanings.exampleTr: O tarzlar artık oldukça modası geçmiş görünüyor.

meanings.en: grassy land where animals such as cattle or sheep can feed
meanings.exampleEn: The cows were grazing in the pasture.
meanings.exampleTr: İnekler otlakta otluyordu.

meanings.en: a form of a language spoken by people in a particular area that differs from the standard language
meanings.exampleEn: The locals spoke in a patois that visitors found hard to understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerliler, ziyaretçilerin anlamakta zorlandığı bir yerel ağızla konuşuyordu.

meanings.en: a member of a family of high social rank, especially in ancient Rome
meanings.exampleEn: He came from an old patrician family.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski bir soylu aileden geliyordu.

meanings.en: showing the qualities of a person of high social class
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with a patrician accent.
meanings.exampleTr: Soylulara özgü bir aksanla konuştu.
